title: Heart failure predicted effector genes (Shah S et al. 2022)
bodyHtml:
This table displays results from the study:

Genome-wide association and Mendelian randomisation analysis provide insights into the pathogenesis of heart failure.
Shah S et al.
Nat Commun. 2020 Jan 9;11(1):163. doi: 10.1038/s41467-019-13690-5.
PMID: 31919418

The authors performed a GWAS meta-analysis of heart failure across 26 studies (47,309 cases and 930,014 controls, all of European ancestry) from the Heart Failure Molecular Epidemiology for Therapeutic Targets (HERMES) Consortium. They then considered nine lines of evidence to prioritize genes at GWAS significant loci. Mouse over the column headers in the table below for explanations of each evidence type.
